versions.content: If parameter FrIf_CtrlIdx of FrIf_EnableTransceiverBranch has an invalid value and if development error detection is enabled (i.e. FrIfDevErrorDetect 86 of 162 Document ID 27: AUTOSAR_SWS_FlexRayInterface Specification of FlexRay Interface AUTOSAR CP R22-11 equals ON), the function FrIf_EnableTransceiverBranch shall report development error code FRIF_E_INV_CTRL_IDX to the Det_ReportError service of the DET module.
